name: 3279-mixedlength-13b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, one in-process engine, no router and no cache tier outside the node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 64, bounded at 1536 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, NO shared prefix, wide length dispersion on both axes: prompt_tokens 256 (stdev 192, clipped to [16, 1024]), output_tokens 128 (stdev 96, clipped to [16, 512]). `request_format: "plain"`, since the base checkpoint ships no chat template, so declared length is wire length. temperature 0.0, and with guidellm's forced `ignore_eos` each request emits exactly its sampled output length.
purpose: A 13-billion-parameter text completion service for 64 concurrent users sending widely varying prompt and response lengths on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.3.3-era AsyncEngineArgs (commit f721096d48a7e3b98dffcb9b400bf58989cef64d): an unknown key
# is a TypeError at engine construction. Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
# Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable).

model: meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16

# The four below are this commit's own resolved argument defaults, written out so they cannot
# drift. `max-num-batched-tokens` is the per-step prefill token budget, derived from the
# checkpoint's 4096-token window; pinning `max-model-len` would silently change it.
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
